title: Curve coefficient pieces
statement:
Fix the coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions] and a
strict Weil complex $(K,\varphi)$ of [def-trf-strict-weil-complex] on $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, with this identification an isomorphism
of $s=\Spec k$-schemes as in [sk-d-weil], where $X_0$ is smooth of
pure dimension one. Fix $m\ge1$ and $x\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})$, and on $X$
write $Z=\Spec k$ and let $i=\bar x:Z\hookrightarrow X$ and
$j:U=X\setminus\{\bar x\}\hookrightarrow X$ be the reduced rational point
and its complementary open immersion. Here $i$ is a section of the
separated structure morphism $X\to\Spec k$, hence a closed immersion by
[lem-weil-pbc-section-separated-closed-immersion].
The *curve pieces* of $K$ at $x$ are

$$
K^Z=Ri_*i^*K,\qquad K^U=j_!j^*K,
$$

using the derived pullbacks of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].
These are the outer terms of the open–closed triangle
$K^U\to K\to K^Z\xrightarrow{+1}$ of [prop-sf-open-closed-triangle-all-stages].
Let $\Phi_m$ be the $m$-th power of the Frobenius of
[def-trf-scheme-frobenius], $\varphi_m$ the iterated Weil map of
[def-trf-iterated-weil-map] (the scheme-Frobenius map
$u_m:\Phi_m^*K\to K$), and $F_{x,m}$ the stalk Frobenius at $\bar x$
of [def-trf-frobenius-operators], which is the stalk map of $\varphi_m$
at the fixed point $\bar x$, with the scheme-Frobenius stalk convention
of [sk-d-weil]. More precisely, the endomorphism on $Li^*K$ is
$Li^*\varphi_m\circ\theta_K^{-1}$, where
$\theta:Li^*L\Phi_m^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Li^*$ is the pullback
composition identification of
[lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] for $\Phi_mi=i$. In the notation
$c_{i,\Phi_m}:L(\Phi_mi)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Li^*L\Phi_m^*$
of [sk-d-weil], the inverse $\theta_K^{-1}$ is inverse pullback
congruence $Li^*K\xrightarrow{\sim}L(\Phi_mi)^*K$ followed by
$c_{i,\Phi_m}(K)$. Thus $Li^*\varphi_m\circ\theta_K^{-1}$
is exactly its fixed-$s$-point stalk composite, specialized to the
coefficient $u_m$ above. Its image under the point
fibre equivalence [lem-weil-point-fibre-equivalence] of
[def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] is the stalk-complex operator
$F_{x,m}$. We use the same symbol for the endomorphism of $Li^*K$
when applying $Ri_*$. The morphism $\Phi_m$ is finite and a
universal homeomorphism: finiteness follows by iterating the finite
scheme Frobenius constructed in [def-trf-scheme-frobenius],
whose finiteness is stated by [lem-trf-scheme-frobenius-finite-radicial], using
[lem-weil-pbc-finite-composition]. For the topological
assertion, [prop-trf-frobenius-factorization] gives the equality of
$k_0$-scheme morphisms
$$
\operatorname{Fr}^{(q^m)}_X=g_\sigma^m\circ\Phi_m,
\qquad
\Phi_m=(g_\sigma^m)^{-1}\circ\operatorname{Fr}^{(q^m)}_X.
$$
Here $g_\sigma$ is the arithmetic scalar automorphism of
[def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. The absolute $q$-power Frobenius is a
universal homeomorphism by the factorization clause of
[prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison]; hence so is its $m$-th iterate.
After every base change, this iterate and the inverse scalar
automorphism are homeomorphisms, so their composite $\Phi_m$ is a
universal homeomorphism, in the sense of
[def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. The factorization is used over
$k_0$; neither scalar Frobenius nor absolute Frobenius is being
asserted to be a $k$-morphism. The point is fixed
as a $k$-point by [thm-trf-frobenius-fixed-points]. Since the underlying
map of a universal homeomorphism is bijective, the only point over
$\bar x$ is $\bar x$ itself. Taking complements gives
$\Phi_m^{-1}(U)=U$. Thus the
square of $j$ over $\Phi_m$ is Cartesian with restriction
$\Phi_{m,U}:U\to U$, by [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product],
and $\Phi_mi=i$. Only inverse-image stability of the open complement
is used; no claim that the square of $i$ is Cartesian is made.
The composition identifications below are those of the ordinary
adjunctions [fix-prop-adjunctions], clause (3).
The pieces lie in $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$: $i^*$ and $i_*$ preserve this
subcategory by [prop-sf-localization-all-stages], clause (3'), and the
localization triangle above rotates to
$K^Z[-1]\to K^U\to K\to K^Z$. Its outer vertices are in
$D^b_{ctf}$, so [lem-weil-finite-ctf-triangulated] puts $K^U$ there too. The induced maps on the two
pieces are:

- on the graph correspondence $(1,\Phi_m)$ of [def-trf-graph-correspondence],
  $u^Z=[i,i]_!(F_{x,m})$, the proper pushforward of
  [def-trf-coefficient-pushforward] of the stalk map, along the proper
  pushforward diagram $(i,i)$ (proper by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper])
  from the point correspondence
  $(\operatorname{id},\operatorname{id})$ on $\{\bar x\}$ with coefficient
  $F_{x,m}$ on $K_{\bar x}$ to the graph $(1,\Phi_m)$ (a diagram because
  $1\circ i=i\circ\operatorname{id}$ and $\Phi_mi=i\circ\operatorname{id}$).
  Both exceptional legs being identities, the exceptional half of
  [def-trf-coefficient-pushforward] is the identity, and
  $u^Z=Ri_*F_{x,m}\circ\gamma$, where
  $\gamma:\Phi_m^*Ri_*i^*K\to Ri_*i^*K$ is the ordinary half, the
  composite of the unit of $i^*\dashv Ri_*$ with $Ri_*$ of the counit,
  through $i^*\Phi_m^*=(\Phi_mi)^*=i^*$. Explicitly, with
  $K_Z=Li^*K$, ordinary unit $\eta$ and counit $\varepsilon$ of
  [fix-prop-adjunctions], clause (1),
  $$
  \gamma=
  Ri_*(\varepsilon_{K_Z})\circ
  Ri_*(\theta_{Ri_*K_Z})\circ
  \eta_{L\Phi_m^*Ri_*K_Z}.
  $$
  This formula uses only the commutativity $\Phi_mi=i$;
- $u^U$, the composite

$$
L\Phi_m^*j_!Lj^*K
\xrightarrow{\mathrm{BC}_!} j_!L\Phi_{m,U}^*Lj^*K
\xrightarrow{j_!\alpha_K} j_!Lj^*L\Phi_m^*K
\xrightarrow{j_!Lj^*\varphi_m}j_!Lj^*K,
$$

  whose first isomorphism is open $!$-base change for the Cartesian
  square of $j$ over $\Phi_m$ ([prop-functor-package], clause (4)).
  Here $\alpha:L\Phi_{m,U}^*Lj^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lj^*L\Phi_m^*$
  is the pullback composition isomorphism of
  [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] for
  $j\Phi_{m,U}=\Phi_mj$. Thus the shorthand $j_!j^*\varphi_m$
  includes this explicitly displayed composition identification.

For an arbitrary morphism $v:L\Phi_m^*K\to K$ of the type used in
[def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism], take $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$
without choosing a Weil structure. Define the endomorphism on $Z$ by
$$
v_Z=Li^*v\circ\theta_K^{-1}:K_Z\to K_Z,
$$
and its stalk-complex image by
$v_{\bar x}=\operatorname{Fib}_s(v_Z)$. Keeping the same geometric
point, complement, $\gamma$, $\alpha$ and base-change isomorphism,
define
$$
u^Z(v)=Ri_*v_Z\circ\gamma,\qquad
u^U(v)=j_!Lj^*v\circ j_!\alpha_K\circ\mathrm{BC}_!.
$$
These formulas use functor action on $v$ and never its inverse.
They are defined for any separated finite-type $X_0$ under the coefficient
conventions: the point is a closed section, scheme Frobenius is finite
and a universal homeomorphism, its fixed point gives the stable open,
and the cited localization results give both coefficient domains.
None of these conditions requires smoothness or dimension one; the
smooth-curve case is the one needed for the trace formula.

split_report.summary: Repaired the sk-d-weil landing return on the current DAG: made the base-change identification explicitly an s-scheme identification and expanded theta inverse as the inverse fixed-point pullback congruence followed by c_{i,Phi_m}, exactly matching the current stalk composite. Revalidated its arbitrary-coefficient and bounded geometric domains while retaining the earlier factorization repair, all logged searches and all construction formulas. No new nodes or Mathlib leaves. The current scheme-Frobenius definition delegates finiteness to lem-trf-scheme-frobenius-finite-radicial; that existing theorem is now cited directly.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q46-d5a813f06 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: FIX with one citation repair; no mathematical fault found. Read the main-20261015 definition and unit (the definition text is identical to master), the full item, and all 26 dependency statements with their blueprint_update texts. Checked Stacks 01KT, 01JR and 0CC8 at their labels. The item is a definition with 0 new nodes and no proof steps, so I checked each construction clause instead. (1) Strict Weil complex is forced because def-trf-iterated-weil-map is defined only on strict pairs. The arbitrary non-invertible v paragraph and the smooth dimension-one hypothesis are kept, so the target is not weakened. (2) x̄ is a section of the separated map a_X, so it is a closed immersion (01KT). Only the underlying open-closed triangle is used, not the Weil-equivariant clause. (3) Φ_m is finite by lem-trf-scheme-frobenius-finite-radicial plus composition. It is a universal homeomorphism because Φ_m=(g_σ^m)^{-1}∘Fr^{(q^m)} over k_0 and absolute Frobenius is one. (4) thm-trf-frobenius-fixed-points gives Φ_m x̄=x̄. Injectivity gives Φ_m^{-1}(U)=U, and 01JR makes the open square Cartesian; the closed square is correctly not claimed Cartesian (A^1 example, ideal t^{q^m}). (5) prop-sf-localization (3') with c=0 gives K^Z in D^b_ctf. The rotated triangle and lem-weil-finite-ctf-triangulated give K^U. (6) Fib_s(Li^*u_m∘θ^{-1}) equals F_{x,m} of def-trf-frobenius-operators clause 2, via ρ and u_m=φ^[m]∘κ^(m), and matches the sk-d-weil stalk composite. (7) The closed map uses diagram (i,i), with b_1g=fc_1 and b_2g=fc_2 checked. The γ types match the ordinary half: η, then Ri_*θ, then Ri_*ε. δ is the identity modulo the ι identifications, consistent with the graph convention u=ι∘v. (8) The open map uses prop-functor-package (4) with g=Φ_m and f=j, on D^b_ctf, followed by j_!α and j_!j^*u_m; the types check. (9) The v-formulas never invert v and hold for any separated finite-type X_0. Small cases checked: K=0, v=0, m=1, X_0=Spec F_q with U empty, and a degree-m point that is not Φ_1-fixed. No duplicate: sk-d-curve-pieces is the imported unit node, correctly in same_as. No cycle (traversal of 13,987 nodes). No SGA citation. tool_uses is empty and none is accepted. Unit realization is correct. Fix (B3): θ and α use the pullback-composition isomorphism without citing the node that defines it, so I cited lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition at both places and added it to stmt_deps, in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-trace-formula/d-curve-pieces.json.
